_comment: Tools for the investigating model (see py/oncall_agent/investigate.py).
noc_slack   read-only Slack: what #comms-noc did for this alert before.
noc_grafana search dashboards, read what a panel queries, run PromQL, render a panel.
Both are read-only apart from render_panel, which writes a PNG into dist/evidence.
Neither can post to Slack — the bot token does that, in our code, after validation.
"command": "python" is only a fallback for running `claude` by hand from an
activated venv. investigate.py rewrites this at run time to the interpreter the
agent itself is running under, so the servers always have their dependencies.
